_about: voi.ci's language choice (docs/voici-front-door.md, Language): the shared rule of language-negotiation.json first; then, for a visitor none of whose preferences ship and who never asked for English, French when a preference names a French-speaking country or a language commonly read alongside French. Checked against apps/voici-site/src/lang.js pickLanguage (the browser site) and apps/com/src/voiciFrontDoor.ts pickVoiciFrontLanguage (the front door the Worker serves). `accept` is an Accept-Language header; `expect` the language shown.
